Uncertain network reconstruction and latent Poisson multigraphs

uncertain_block_state.Rd

Native C++ implementations of Bayesian network reconstruction from noisy or uncertain measurements (Peixoto 2018) and erased Poisson multigraph inference (Peixoto 2020), matching graph-tool's MeasuredBlockState, MixedMeasuredBlockState, UncertainBlockState, LatentMultigraphBlockState, and latent_multigraph().

Usage

measured_block_state(graph, n = NULL, x = NULL,
  n_default = 1L, x_default = 0L,
  fn_params = list(alpha = 1, beta = 1),
  fp_params = list(mu = 1, nu = 1),
  lp = NA_real_, lq = NA_real_,
  nested = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  latent_edges = NULL, latent_weights = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = FALSE, q_max = Inf)

mixed_measured_block_state(graph, n = NULL, x = NULL,
  n_default = 1L, x_default = 0L,
  fn_params = list(alpha = 1, beta = 1),
  fp_params = list(mu = 1, nu = 1),
  nested = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  latent_edges = NULL, latent_weights = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = FALSE, q_max = Inf)

uncertain_block_state(graph, q = NULL, q_default = 0,
  nested = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  latent_edges = NULL, latent_weights = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = FALSE, q_max = Inf)

latent_multigraph_block_state(graph, nested = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  latent_weights = NULL, degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = TRUE, q_max = Inf)

uncertain_description_length(state, sbm = TRUE, density = FALSE,
  aE = 1, breakdown = FALSE)

measured_error_posterior(state)

edge_probabilities(state, edges, log = TRUE, epsilon = 1e-8)

reconstruct_network(state, nsamples = 200L, burnin = 100L, thin = 1L,
  beta = 1, pedges = 0.5, ph = 0.1, hstep = 1,
  c = 1, d = 0.01, init_sbm = TRUE,
  collect_partitions = FALSE, threshold = 0.5)

latent_multigraph(graph, epsilon = 1e-8, max_niter = 0L)

Arguments

graph

A graph created by graph_create.

n, x

Total measurement trials \(n_{ij}\) and positive observations \(x_{ij}\) for each observed edge of graph, supplied as a numeric vector of length graph_num_edges(graph), an edge property name, or NULL (defaulting to 1).

n_default, x_default

Default measurement counts for unobserved dyads not listed in graph.

fn_params

Named list list(alpha, beta) giving Beta prior parameters for the false-negative error rate \(p\).

fp_params

Named list list(mu, nu) giving Beta prior parameters for the false-positive error rate \(q\).

lp, lq

Optional fixed log error rates \(\ln p\) and \(\ln q\) (\(\le 0\)). Leave as NA_real_ to integrate out unknown error rates under their Beta priors.

q

Extraneous edge probability estimates \(q_{ij} \in [0, 1]\) for observed edges of graph, given as a numeric vector, edge property name, or NULL.

q_default

Default probability in \([0, 1]\) for unobserved dyads.

nested

Whether to place a nested hierarchical SBM prior (TRUE) or a flat SBM prior (FALSE) on the latent multigraph.

blocks

Optional initial partition: NULL, a length-\(N\) integer vector, a hierarchy list, or a fitted block state.

latent_edges, latent_weights

Optional initial latent multigraph edgelist (2-column matrix) and integer multiplicities. Defaults to the edges of graph with unit weight.

degree_corrected

Whether the SBM prior is degree-corrected.

degree_prior

Degree sequence hyperprior ("distributed" or "uniform").

self_loops

Whether self-loops are valid dyads in the latent graph.

q_max

Maximum degree cached in the partition-count table.

state

A rgraphtool_uncertain_block_state object.

sbm

Include the SBM prior description length (TRUE) or return only the measurement negative log-likelihood (FALSE).

density

Include an optional Poisson edge-count density prior with mean aE.

aE

Expected total number of edges when density = TRUE.

breakdown

If TRUE, return a named list separating total, measurement, and SBM description lengths plus Beta posterior parameters.

edges

Two-column matrix or data.frame of 1-based vertex pairs to query.

log

Return log-probabilities (TRUE) or probabilities (FALSE).

epsilon

Convergence tolerance for latent multiplicity summation or EM iteration.

nsamples, burnin, thin

Number of posterior samples collected, burn-in sweeps discarded, and sweeps between consecutive samples.

beta

Inverse MCMC temperature (default 1 for posterior sampling).

pedges

Probability of performing an edge-multiplicity sweep versus an SBM partition sweep.

ph, hstep

Hyperparameter move probability and proposal step size for mixed_measured_block_state().

c, d

SBM proposal mixing and empty-group creation parameters.

init_sbm

If TRUE and state starts from a single-group partition, initialize the SBM hierarchy on the initial latent graph before MCMC.

collect_partitions

If TRUE, return sampled SBM partitions in partitions.

threshold

Marginal edge-probability threshold used to construct the returned consensus_graph.

max_niter

Maximum EM iterations for latent_multigraph() (0L means run until epsilon convergence).

Details

All four reconstruction models combine an exact dynamic-edge flat or nested SBM prior with a measurement likelihood over observed dyads:

  • measured_block_state(): repeated binary observations \((n_{ij}, x_{ij})\) with unknown Beta-prior or fixed homogeneous false-negative (\(p\)) and false-positive (\(q\)) rates.

  • mixed_measured_block_state(): heterogeneous per-dyad Beta-Binomial error rates with joint hyperparameter MCMC over \((\alpha, \beta, \mu, \nu)\).

  • uncertain_block_state(): extraneous per-edge probability estimates \(q_{ij}\) and default non-edge probability \(q_{\mathrm{default}}\).

  • latent_multigraph_block_state(): Bayesian posterior over latent edge multiplicities and self-loops conditioned on an erased simple graph.

latent_multigraph() implements the fast \(O(V + E)\) Expectation-Maximization algorithm of Peixoto (2020) for maximum-likelihood expected edge and self-loop multiplicities.

Value

Constructors return a rgraphtool_uncertain_block_state. uncertain_description_length() returns a numeric scalar (or breakdown list). measured_error_posterior() returns Beta posterior parameters, means, and standard deviations for \(p\) and \(q\). edge_probabilities() returns a numeric vector of conditional (log-) probabilities. reconstruct_network() returns a rgraphtool_reconstruction containing posterior marginal edge probabilities (edges), a thresholded consensus_graph, the final state, posterior error-rate traces, and entropy history. latent_multigraph() returns a rgraphtool_latent_multigraph with expected edge and self-loop weights (edges), vertex propensities theta_out/theta_in, and convergence diagnostics.

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2018). Reconstructing networks with unknown and heterogeneous errors. Physical Review X 8, 041011. doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.8.041011

Peixoto, T. P. (2020). Latent Poisson models for networks with heterogeneous density. Physical Review E 102, 012309. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.102.012309

See also

predict_edges, evaluate_edge_prediction, latent_closure_block_state, demo("uncertain_reconstruction")

Examples

g <- graph_create(8, directed = FALSE)
e <- rbind(t(combn(1:4, 2)), t(combn(5:8, 2)), c(4, 5))
graph_add_edges(g, e, properties = list(n = rep(3, nrow(e)), x = rep(3, nrow(e))))
st <- measured_block_state(g, n = "n", x = "x", n_default = 3L, x_default = 0L)
uncertain_description_length(st)
#> [1] 32.68894
em <- latent_multigraph(g)
head(em$edges)
#>   from to   weight is_self_loop
#> 1    1  2 1.253635        FALSE
#> 2    1  3 1.253635        FALSE
#> 3    1  4 1.456230        FALSE
#> 4    2  3 1.253635        FALSE
#> 5    2  4 1.456230        FALSE
#> 6    3  4 1.456230        FALSE
